text:
jordan: noticing a spike in conntrack/TIME_WAIT on APAC NATGW — several GPU nodes failing KMS decrypts during boot. warm-pool join rate dropped ~40% :grimacing:

maria: saw the same, pods stuck in Init waiting for keystore. logs show repeated tcp timeouts to privatelink endpoint.

sean: can you paste the node logs? thinking conntrack exhaustion or natgw scale lag.

jordan: paste logs:
```
2026-03-21T08:12:03Z node-az-22 kubelet: dial tcp x.x.x.x:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-21T08:12:04Z keystore-client: decrypt error: rpc deadline exceeded
2026-03-21T08:12:05Z kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
```

priya: nf_conntrack table full matches. We recently increased pod density on GPU subnets to save costs. suspect conntrack entries from many short-lived TLS sessions to keystore endpoint.

sre-oncall: alert-bot triggered: APAC-KMS-DECRYPT-FAILURES (sev3) — ongoing for ~6m. fallback route to regional keystore not configured for these nodes.

maria: quick mitigation: reduce max ephemeral connections (pooling) on keystore-client side? but boot path hard to change quickly. another option: temporarily increase NATGW count & conntrack table size on nodes.

sean: to add data: `ss -tan | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l` on an affected node -> ~120k TIME_WAIT (capacity is 200k). so close to threshold.

jordan: I'm going to flip autoscale on the NATGW and bump conntrack on node AMI. who can run the playbook to add one natgw and update asg?

priya: I can run the NATGW scale now. will also open a short maintenance window with security so it's recorded for audit logs.

maria: note for compliance: any NATGW scaling and VPC route changes must be logged. please annotate the change with ticket id and reason. we'll need to export flow logs and attach to the incident.

priya: running command now: `infractl natgw scale --region ap-southeast-1 --set 2` -> deploy-bot: triggering infra job 8672.

deploy-bot: infra job 8672 started by priya (natgw scale to 2). logs stream: https://ci.company/run/8672

ops-bot: audit: NATGW scale triggered by priya, reason: conntrack exhaustion causing KMS decrypt failures for GPU nodes. ticket: INF-5421.

sean: after NATGW up, please watch conntrack again. also we should throttle client reconnects in the keystore client library to reuse connections (longer term).

jordan: quick check 90s after change: `ss -tan | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l` -> 45k. decrypts are succeeding, warm-pool join rate back to normal.

maria: good. next steps:
- short: ship conntrack sysctl bump in the GPU AMI to 300k (opt-in canary).
- medium: add a regional keystore fallback for boot-time decrypts (policy + routing).
- long: instrument keystore client to connection-pool and backoff jitter to avoid thundering herd.

priya: I'll raise PR for AMI sysctl and schedule canary for staging. assigning to sean for client changes and to jordan for routing fallback design.

jordan: note on cost: adding an extra NATGW adds ~$180/month in APAC plus some ELB/eip charges — small compared to failed onboarding time but call out in postmortem.

maria: for the audit trail — I'll bundle the flow logs, infra job, and ops-bot audit entry into INF-5421 before we close. security wants a short blameless postmortem.

sre-oncall: marking incident as mitigated (natgw scaled, conntrack down, nodes rejoined). will keep open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

jordan: thanks all — follow-ups: PRs for AMI/sysctl (priya), client pooling (sean), fallback routing doc (jordan). closing thread when PRs exist.
